messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: zh-HK BLEU dropped 14% vs baseline for rwd-infer-v2.3-quant-int8. affected split: translation-multilang/cjk-mix. check per-example diffs.
anya: seeing this now, ouch. any obvious noisy changes in the run? :thinking_face:
kenji: quick glance at the diff heatmap — spike aligns with emoji/punctuation buckets. looks like tokenization boundary shifts when emoji are mixed with CJK punctuation.
sophia: posting two failing samples:
```
PROMPT: "請翻譯：今晚我們去吃壽司🍣，然後看電影。"
REFERENCE: "Let's translate: Tonight we go eat sushi 🍣, then watch a movie."
GENERATED: "Translate: tonight we eat sushi , then watch a movie ."  <-- lost emoji integration, extra spaces before punctuation
METRICS: BLEU -0.21, chrF -0.12
```
kenji: that spacing looks like token detokenization bug post-quant. maybe int8 kernel uses a different de-tokenizer path.
mohammed: also saw similar for JP+emoji and mixed Latin with CJK parentheses. nightly run used tokenizers v2.5.0 — we changed BPE merges two days ago (liao PR).
liao: yup I merged tokenizer patch: tightened merge rules for CJK+emoji. I assumed detok stable but maybe quant runtime dropped a postproc flag.
anya: good catch. can someone reproduce locally with the exact nightly config? command we use:
```
./eval/run_eval.sh --model rwd-infer-v2.3-quant-int8 --suite translation-multilang/cjk-mix --tokenizer v2.5.0 --snapshot 2026-03-19T02:00Z
```
mohammed: I'll run float16 and int8 locally and diff outputs. if int8 shows detok spacing but f16 ok, then runtime quant path likely at fault.
kenji: alternative quick test: run only detokenize step on a few samples with both tokenizer v2.5.0 and previous v2.4.7 to isolate tokenizer vs runtime.
sophia: adding a failing example with Arabic punctuation inside same thread for cross-script failure. similar symptom: extra spaces before Arabic comma.
opsbot: deploy note: no live customer impact flagged yet. only nightly eval alerts. opsbot: creating ticket ML-2872 and assigning to @mohammed and @liao.
anya: plan: (1) mohammed reproduce int8 vs f16, (2) kenji run detok-only diffs, (3) liao revert tokenizer tweak on a branch and run eval, (4) if reproduces, bisect quant kernels. update here with short results.
kenji: I'll run detok diff now and post samples in 30m.
mohammed: started int8/f16 compare, ETA ~45m. attaching quick log when done.
liao: I'll prep a revert branch and run the small suite on my workstation.
anya: thanks all. keep thread focused — if we confirm tokenizer patch is culprit we can push quick fix and rerun nightly.
```
